title: Israel's Deepdub dubs films and series with artificial intelligence, in the original actors' voices

trailer.text: Deepdub is an Israeli startup from Tel Aviv, founded in 2019 by the brothers Ofir and Nir Krakowski.
The company developed artificial intelligence technology for dubbing films, series and games.
It takes a short voice sample of the original actors and builds from it a model that carries their voice into another language.
According to TechCrunch, dubbing a two-hour film usually takes 15 to 20 weeks, and Deepdub completes it in about four weeks.
Later the company launched Deepdub GO, in which creators can dub in their own voice into 65 languages.

paragraphs.text: According to ICE, dubbing a film or series takes several months and requires a lot of money, people and resources.
In conventional dubbing, five minutes of narration can require an hour in a recording studio.
According to one calculator, dubbing a simple video costs $75 per minute.
The meaning is sometimes affected as well. To match the actor's mouth movement, sentences have to be stretched out or cut shorter using different words, and this can slightly change what is said.
The creator of "Squid Game" even recommended that viewers watch the series with subtitles.
Meanwhile, demand is growing as the streaming industry becomes more competitive.
According to Greg Peters of Netflix, the company dubbed some 5 million minutes of content in 2021.
According to Statista, 59% of U.S. adults said they prefer a foreign film dubbed into English over a film with subtitles.
According to Slator, a shortage of professionals and capacity has become a significant challenge in the field.
Deepdub was founded in 2019 by two brothers: Ofir Krakowski, the company's CEO, and Nir Krakowski, its CTO.
Both have backgrounds in machine learning and artificial intelligence.
Ofir served in the Israeli Air Force's Ofek 324 technology unit, and Nir was one of the founders of the Shin Bet's cyber unit.
The goal they set for the company was to bridge the language barrier and the cultural gap in entertainment for international audiences.
According to the founders, they want to enable billions of people to watch any content in their own language.
According to Slator, the company emerged from stealth in December 2020.
According to Slator, Ofir Krakowski observed a spike in demand for machine dubbing during the pandemic.
The system starts from a few minutes of the original actors' voices.
From this it builds a model that carries the voice characteristics into the target language.
According to VentureBeat, neural networks separate the voices in the soundtrack and replace them in the original audio tracks.
It is not just a machine. At every step there are human experts who oversee the work and make corrections as needed.
According to Ofir Krakowski, the company offers the entire process: transcription, translation, adaptation and subtitling.
According to VentureBeat, the system does not yet dub in real time, but it fits into post-production work.
According to ICE, customers complete the dubbing of a full film in four weeks, compared with 15 to 20 weeks with existing solutions.
The details of the process are a company secret.
In October 2021, according to Slator, Deepdub announced its role in the first feature film dubbed entirely by artificial intelligence: Every Time I Die.
According to VentureBeat, the company dubbed the 2019 film into Spanish and Portuguese.
According to ICE, by 2022 the company's technology had been used to dub dozens of titles.
At the time it was available in English, Spanish and Portuguese, and more languages were expected to be added later.

stations.title: From Hollywood to news from Israel

paragraphs.text: Deepdub signed a partnership with the streaming service Topic.com to dub its catalog of foreign shows into English.
According to Slator, the deal was signed in December 2021.
The company has worked with Hollywood studios on dozens of film and television projects.
Some of these shows are streaming on Hulu and Amazon Prime.
According to the Jerusalem Post, Deepdub contributed to the dubbing of several films being screened in theaters worldwide.
The company also works with Reshet 13, one of Israel's leading television broadcasters.
Reshet will use it to dub its news items, starting with Spanish and English.
This will allow Reshet to quickly upload news to its new YouTube FAST channel.
Reshet CEO Emiliano Calemzuk said the technology expands Reshet's potential worldwide news audience.
Deepdub launched Deepdub GO, a platform for video and audio localization and creation.
It is intended for businesses, advertising agencies, learning platforms and content creators.
Users upload a video, choose a style and languages, and shortly afterwards the video is ready for download.
Creators can use it to dub in their own voice into 65 languages.
It is also possible to record one's voice to show the system what emotion should be heard.
Deepdub and the transcription company Verbit announced a partnership for automated dubbing in many languages.
According to both companies, the joint service shortens dubbing time by days and brings accessibility and translation into a single process.
In April 2026 Deepdub launched what it calls the first AI-agent-based dubbing co-worker.
According to the company, it now works in more than 130 languages and accents.
According to the CEO of Love TV Channels, thanks to Deepdub content reached millions of viewers on FAST channels in Europe, in Spanish, Italian and French for the first time.
In February 2022 Deepdub raised $20 million in a Series A round, led by the New York-based investment firm Insight Partners.
Booster Ventures and Stardom Ventures also participated, as did a new investor, Swift VC.
The angel investors included Emiliano Calemzuk, former President of Fox Television Studios, and Kevin Reilly, former Chief Content Officer of HBO Max.
According to Slator, the round brought the company's total funds raised to $26 million.
The money was intended to expand the company's sales and delivery teams worldwide.
He said he believes Deepdub is the next great leap in global content distribution.
Nir Krakowski said the round is an acknowledgement of the technology they built, in an industry where every pixel and every sound wave is rigorously examined.
According to him, the next challenge is to optimize and scale a process that spans exabytes of video, audio, language and text.
Deepdub received certification from the Motion Picture Association's Trusted Partner Network (TPN).
It is the first AI-powered dubbing solution to be accepted as a trusted service provider in the entertainment industry.
AI dubbing raises ethical questions, for example whether it is permissible to recreate the voice of a person who has died.
Studios are increasingly adding provisions to contracts that allow synthetic voices to be used in place of actors.
According to VentureBeat, Deepdub says it does not create deepfakes, and that it works with actors so they understand how their voices are used.
According to the Washington Post, content dubbed by artificial intelligence without attention to detail could lose its "local flavor."
According to Slator, film and TV customers are reluctant to abandon the familiar work practices of dubbing studios.

claims.quote: Users simply upload their videos to the Deepdub GO platform, choose the video style and desired languages, and the video is available for download shortly.

claims.text: ב-Deepdub GO משתמשים יכולים לספק הקלטת קול שתשמש מדריך לביטוי הרגשי הרצוי של האודיו שנוצר בבינה מלאכותית.
claims.quote: Users can provide a voice recording to act as a guide for the desired emotional expressivity of the AI-generated audio

claims.text: דיפדאב וחברת התמלול Verbit הודיעו על שותפות לאוטומציה של דיבוב רב-לשוני בקנה מידה רחב.
claims.quote: Voice AI company Deepdub and AI-powered transcription provider Verbit announced this week a partnership to streamline and automate multilingual dubbing at scale

claims.text: לפי החברות, ההצעה המשותפת מקצרת את לוחות הזמנים המסורתיים של דיבוב בימים ומאחדת נגישות ולוקליזציה בתהליך אחד.
claims.quote: The companies say the offering reduces traditional dubbing timelines by days and brings accessibility and localization into a single workflow.

claims.text: באפריל 2026 דיפדאב, חברת בינה מלאכותית קולית, השיקה את מה שהיא מכנה העמית הראשון לדיבוב מבוסס סוכן בינה מלאכותית.
claims.quote: Deepdub, a foundational voice AI company, has launched the first Agentic Dubbing Co-Worker.

claims.text: לפי מנכ"לית Love TV Channels, דיפדאב אפשרה להביא תוכן למיליוני צופים בערוצי ה-FAST האירופיים בספרדית, איטלקית וצרפתית לראשונה.
claims.quote: Deepdub has already enabled us to bring content to millions of viewers across our European FAST channels in Spanish, Italian, and French for the first time.

claims.text: סטארטאפ תל אביבי בשם דיפדאב סגר סבב גיוס סדרה A בסך 20 מיליון דולר בהובלת חברת ההשקעות Insight Partners מניו יורק.
claims.quote: The Tel Aviv startup has now closed on $20 million in Series A funding for its efforts, led by New York-based investment firm Insight Partners.

claims.text: משקיעות קיימות, Booster Ventures ו-Stardom Ventures, השתתפו בסבב יחד עם משקיעה חדשה, Swift VC.
claims.quote: Existing investors Booster Ventures and Stardom Ventures also participated in the round, alongside new investors at Swift VC.

claims.text: בין משקיעי האנג'ל בסבב היו אמיליאנו קלמזוק, לשעבר נשיא Fox Television Studios, וקווין ריילי, לשעבר מנהל התוכן הראשי של HBO Max.
claims.quote: Angel investors joining this round include Emiliano Calemzuk former President of Fox Television Studios, Kevin Reilly former CCO of HBO Max

claims.text: לפי Slator, הסבב הביא את סך הכספים שגייסה דיפדאב ל-26 מיליון דולר.
claims.quote: On February 10, 2022, machine dubbing company Deepdub announced it had raised USD 20m in series A funding, taking total funds raised to USD 26m.

claims.text: הכספים ישמשו להרחבת צוותי המכירות והאספקה של החברה בעולם.
claims.quote: The funds will be used to expand the global reach of the company's sales and delivery teams

claims.text: ג'ורג' מתיו מ-Insight Partners אמר שהוא מאמין שדיפדאב מייצגת את הקפיצה הגדולה הבאה בהפצת תוכן עולמית, במעורבות ובצריכה.
claims.quote: We believe Deepdub represents the next great leap forward in global content distribution, engagement and consumption.

claims.text: ניר קרקובסקי, מנהל הטכנולוגיות, אמר שהסבב הוא הכרה בטכנולוגיה המהפכנית שהחברה בנתה, בתעשייה שבה כל פיקסל וכל גל קול נבחנים בקפדנות.
claims.quote: This funding round is an acknowledgement of the revolutionary technology that we have built, taking generative AI to an industry where every pixel and every sound wave is rigorously examined.

claims.text: לדברי ניר קרקובסקי, האתגר כעת הוא להמשיך לייעל ולהרחיב תהליך שמקיף אקסה-בייטים של וידאו, אודיו, שפה וטקסט.
claims.quote: The challenge now is to continue optimizing and scaling a process that spans exabytes of video, audio, language and text.

claims.text: דיבוב בבינה מלאכותית מעורר שאלות אתיות, למשל האם לשחזר את קולו של אדם שנפטר.
claims.quote: AI dubs pose ethical questions, like whether to recreate the voice of a person who's passed away.

claims.text: אולפנים מוסיפים יותר ויותר סעיפים בחוזים שמבקשים להשתמש בקולות סינתטיים במקום שחקנים.
claims.quote: studios are increasingly adding provisions in contracts that seek to use synthetic voices in place of performers

claims.text: לפי VentureBeat, דיפדאב אומרת שהיא אינה עוסקת ביצירת דיפפייקס ועובדת עם שחקנים כדי שיבינו כיצד משתמשים בקולותיהם.
claims.quote: Deepdub says that it's not engaged in creating "deepfakes" and works with performers to ensure that they understand how their voices are being used.

claims.text: לפי העיתון וושינגטון פוסט, תוכן מדובב בבינה מלאכותית בלי תשומת לב לפרטים עלול לאבד את ה"טעם המקומי" שלו.
claims.quote: AI-dubbed content without attention to detail could lose its "local flavor."

claims.text: לקוחות קולנוע וטלוויזיה גילו חוסר נכונות לנטוש את שיטות העבודה המוכרות של אולפני דיבוב מסורתיים.
claims.quote: Film and TV customers have proven reluctant to abandon the trusted work practices of brick-and-mortar dubbing studios

claims.text: ניר קרקובסקי אמר ל-VentureBeat שמודלי הבינה המלאכותית מאפשרים לשכפל מאפייני קול באמצעות לא יותר משלוש דקות של נתוני קול.
claims.quote: [Our] AI models enable replication of voice characteristics using not more than three minutes of voice data.

claims.text: לפי TechCrunch, הסטארטאפ יכפיל את צוותו הנוכחי של 30 עובדים במשרה מלאה, רובם בתל אביב.
claims.quote: The startup said it will use the funds to double its current team of 30 full-time employees, most of whom are based in Tel Aviv.

claims.text: לפי CTech, החברה מעסיקה 30 עובדים ומתכננת לגייס עשרות נוספים בישראל ובארה"ב.
claims.quote: Deepdub currently employs 30 people and intends to recruit dozens more in Israel and the U.S.

claims.text: לפי Slator, החברה מעסיקה כעת יותר מ-30 אנשים, לעומת שבעה בתחילת 2021.
claims.quote: the company now employs more than 30 people — up from seven at the start of 2021

claims.text: לפי TechCrunch, דיפדאב הפכה לחברה הראשונה שדיבבה סרט באורך מלא שלם לספרדית לטינו-אמריקנית באמצעות קולות בינה מלאכותית.
claims.quote: Deepdub also became the first company to dub an entire feature-length film into Latin American Spanish utilizing AI voices

claims.text: Every Time I Die, הסרט הראשון בעולם שדובב על ידי בינה מלאכותית, הוצג בנטפליקס באנגלית.
claims.quote: Every Time I Die, הסרט הראשון בעולם שדובב על ידי בינה מלאכותית והוצג בנטפליקס באנגלית.

claims.text: לפי גלובס-כלכליסט (CTech), אופיר שירת ביחידת אופק 324 של חיל האוויר, וניר היה בין מקימי היחידה הסייברית של השב"כ.
claims.quote: Ofir, the CEO, served in the Israel Air Force’s Ofek 324 technology unit while Nir was one of the founders of the Shin Bet’s cyber unit.

claims.text: ניר קרקובסקי הקים בעבר יחד עם אחרים את Metapacket, שער רשת שנתמך על ידי Y Combinator.
claims.quote: had previously co-founded the Y Combinator-backed web gateway Metapacket.

claims.text: לפי TechCrunch, דיפדאב אומרת שהיא עובדת עם אולפני הוליווד קטנים וגדולים, אך אינה יכולה לנקוב בשמותיהם בגלל הסכמי סודיות.
claims.quote: Deepdub says it’s working with both small and large Hollywood studios on projects, but isn’t able to say which ones due to non-disclosure agreements.

quote_translations.c77: The company's headquarters are located in Tel Aviv, where its research and development activity is concentrated.
quote_translations.c10: The Israeli startup Deepdub, which developed AI technology for dubbing films, series and games, has completed a Series A funding round of 20 million dollars.
quote_translations.c21: The platform makes it possible to clone the voice of the actors from the source content into the target language, through a voice sample of only two minutes.
quote_translations.c8: Deepdub was founded in 2019 by the brothers Ofir Krakowski, the company's CEO, and Nir Krakowski, its CTO.
quote_translations.c11: The dubbing process for films and series currently takes several months and requires a large financial investment, manpower and resources.
quote_translations.c9: Ofir served in a variety of roles in the Air Force's technology unit "Ofek 324", and Nir was one of the founders of the cyber unit in the Shin Bet.
quote_translations.c76: With the aim of revolutionizing the field of content consumption and enabling billions of people around the world to experience any content in their own language for the first time
quote_translations.c19: Today the company enables its customers to complete dubbing for a full film within only four weeks, compared with 15-20 weeks using existing solutions.
quote_translations.c34: The company's technology has been used to date to dub dozens of titles
quote_translations.c29: The platform is currently available in several different languages, including English, Spanish and Portuguese, and is expected to expand to additional languages later.
quote_translations.c33: Every Time I Die, the world's first film dubbed by artificial intelligence, which was shown on Netflix in English.
